description: Source code for OpenSSL's X.509 directory lookup implementation, including directory management, certificate loading, and hashing functions.

classes.name: BY_DIR_HASH
classes.description: Structure representing a hash and its suffix for directory lookup.

classes.name: BY_DIR_ENTRY
classes.description: Structure representing a directory entry with associated hashes.

classes.name: BY_DIR
classes.description: Structure representing a collection of directories and associated buffers.

methods.name: dir_ctrl
methods.description: Control function for directory lookup, handling commands like adding directories.

methods.name: new_dir
methods.description: Initializes a new directory lookup structure.

methods.name: free_dir
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a directory lookup structure.

methods.name: add_cert_dir
methods.description: Adds a directory to the list of directories to search for certificates.

methods.name: get_cert_by_subject
methods.description: Retrieves a certificate or CRL by subject name from directories.
